description: PONV1 isolate PONV1, segment 1 (PQ030832.1, 41,709 bp) and segment 2 (PV579160.1, 22,622 bp), complete sequences (GenBank). Lengths match Zhong et al. 2025 (41.709 and 22.622 kb).
accession_source: Zhong et al. 2025 PNAS, Data, Materials, and Software Availability (PMC12377751): PONV1 = PQ030832 and PV579160.
used_for: Per-animal viral read QC (--viral_reference) for the prespecified within-farm PONV1-positive vs PONV1-negative mantle comparison. Per-segment detection is read from each library's VIRAL_QUANT quant.sf.
caveats: Kept under the study's own directory because data/reference/pathogens/ is outside a study PR's scope. Counts are QC, not a titre.
